sql: select (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 01:28:57+00' and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')) as settled_v2, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 01:28:57+00') as created_v2, (select count(*) from experiment_deployment_arms eda join experiment_deployments ed on ed.id=eda.deployment_id where eda.strategy_tag='mmsell10' and ed.ended_at is null) as active_arms, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as cands_10m, (select max(started_at)::text from bot_runs) as last_boot, (select count(distinct x.market_ticker) from (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.strategy from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Cmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status in ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled')) x left join lateral (select coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity) as qty from positions p where p.market_ticker=x.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) pos on true where pos.qty is null or abs(pos.qty) > 0.01) as cmmsell10_open, now()::text as now_utc
